svg.title: CANH, every bit folded
svg.desc: CANH, every bit folded. unit_interval: 2.01 us. frequency: 498 kHz. unit_interval_source: recovered from the shortest run between crossings (NRZ data). periods_folded: 59. kind: data: phases carry both levels, so eye_width is the opening at the threshold. level_low: 2.88 V. level_high: 3.94 V. threshold: 3.43 V. eye_height: 1.02 V. eye_width: 2.01 us. eye_width_percent_of_ui: 100 %. jitter_tie_pp: 130 ns. jitter_bursts: 3. jitter_cycle_to_cycle_pp: 64.2 ns. fitted_period: 2.01 us. unit interval recovered from the shortest run between crossings (117 runs in 5 lengths, 1..5 units): intervals between like-going crossings on this line are multiples of it, so their median (3.00 units) is not the unit interval. the eye never closes: no sample falls between the two levels anywhere in the period, so eye_width is capped at one unit interval and says nothing about the edges — read the jitter numbers instead. the crossings fall into 3 bursts separated by idle gaps; time interval error is the worst burst's, each fitted against its own grid — one grid across all of them would report the phase difference between bursts as jitter.
svg.text: unit_interval=2.01 us frequency=498 kHz periods_folded=59 level_low=2.88 V level_high=3.94 V
unit_interval_source=recovered from the shortest run between crossings (NRZ data) threshold=3.43 V
